name: Sven Simon - Projet du Conseil
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive laying down detailed arrangements for the exercise of the right to vote and stand as a candidate in elections to the European Parliament for Union citizens residing in a Member State of which they are not nationals (recast)
part_text:
The European Parliament approves a Council plan to update the rules for European Union citizens who live in another European Union country and want to vote or run in European Parliament elections there. The plan aims to make information and registration easier, stop people voting twice, and improve sharing of data between countries. The Parliament accepts the Council's text without changes, but criticises the Council for ignoring its earlier suggestions.

- **What changes:** clearer information, easier registration, and better checks against double voting for mobile citizens.
- **Who it affects:** about 13.7 million European Union citizens living in a country that is not their own.
- **What happens next:** the Council must tell Parliament if it plans to change the text, and consult it again.
